_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Omuzannyi Snake ku {width}×{height} grid.
Ogola omuzannyi {player_id}. Ezisa kuwa: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (oba w/s/a/d).
Ekyunuuzo: okutamu buli lunaku oba ukome kuwa munoonyi n'olweza ekisa ekikulu (omisi y'ekitundu {max_turns}).

game_action.invalid_death: Omusota {player_id} yafa olw'okutambula mu ngeri etali ya bwenkanya.

outcome.outlived: Mchezaji aliishi muda mrefu kuliko wengine wote.
outcome.turn_limit: Ekigero ky'ekikopo kituuse - ekifo ekisingayo obulungi kiwangula tie-break.
